abstract: BACKGROUND/AIM: We evaluated the clinical outcomes of patients with metastatic germ cell tumors (GCT) treated at our hospital, which belongs to a regional cancer center. PATIENTS AND METHODS: Data pertaining to patients with metastatic GCT were obtained between April 2007-October 2017 and was retrospectively analyzed. Key outcome measures included objective response rates and survival rates. RESULTS: All 42 patients received chemotherapy [complete response: eight (19.0%); partial response: 21 (50.0%); stable disease (SD): nine (21.4%); progressive disease: four patients (9.5%)]. Post-chemotherapeutic surgery was performed for seven out of 21 cases of partial response and two out of nine of stable disease. The 5-year survival rates of patients with good, intermediate and poor prognosis (International Germ Cell Consensus Classification) were 100%, 100%, and 71.4%, respectively. Patients who received induction chemotherapy at other hospitals had significantly poorer prognosis than those at our hospital (p=0.0043). CONCLUSION: Patients with metastatic GCT should preferably receive chemotherapy at an experienced institution.
abstract_ja:
背景/目的:地域がん診療拠点病院に属する当院で治療を受けた転移性胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)患者の臨床転帰を評価した。

患者および方法:2007年4月から2017年10月の間に転移性GCTと診断された患者のデータを取得し、後方視的に解析した。主要評価項目は奏効率および生存率であった。

結果:全42例が化学療法を受けた[完全奏効:8例(19.0%);部分奏効:21例(50.0%);安定(SD):9例(21.4%);進行:4例(9.5%)]。部分奏効の21例中7例、安定の9例中2例に化学療法後の手術が行われた。国際胚細胞コンセンサス分類(IGCCCG)による予後良好群、中間群、予後不良群の5年生存率は、それぞれ100%、100%、71.4%であった。他施設で導入化学療法を受けた患者は、当院で治療を受けた患者より有意に予後が不良であった(p=0.0043)。

結論:転移性GCT患者は、経験豊富な施設で化学療法を受けることが望ましい。
